verdict.rationale: The Wyoming Secretary of State is a government business-registry and filing portal, offering entity filings, annual reports, good-standing certificates and searches. It does not host user-authored automations, so versioning, reviewing and rolling back automations is a category error for this kind of product. Nothing in the evidence shows the product ships such a capability; an emailed annual-report reminder is a notification, not a user automation.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
